target_customer: Engineering teams shipping LLM applications and agents who need tracing, evaluation and monitoring
problem: LLM apps fail in unpredictable ways and teams lacked visibility into prompts, responses, quality drift and hallucinations.
business_model: Open source SDK (OpenLLMetry) with paid SaaS platform

founders.name: Nir Gazit
education: MSc Computer Science, Hebrew University of Jerusalem
founders.background_notes: Former chief architect at Fiverr and four years at Google building LLM systems for engagement prediction.

founders.name: Gal Kleinman
founders.background_notes: R&D group manager at Fiverr, led ML infrastructure.

technical_complexity.rationale: Instrumenting many LLM and vector database libraries on top of OpenTelemetry is solid engineering but not research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Open source instrumentation spread widely but was easy to copy; the commercial layer competed with several observability tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Observability vendors and LangChain added LLM tracing; ServiceNow acquired Traceloop in March 2026 for its AI Control Tower, reported at 60 to 80 million dollars by Calcalist.

market_need_then: Production LLM apps had hard to debug failures, and tracing demand rose through 2023; early traction was open source installs, about half a million monthly by May 2025.

identity.visual_style: Developer focused with team chat mockups

branding.brand_signature: OpenLLMetry, the open source SDK name, a play on OpenTelemetry and LLM
branding.community_and_virality: OpenLLMetry has a Slack community, 60+ contributors and 5.6 thousand stars at May 2025, with early adopters named as IBM, Microsoft, Cisco and Dynatrace.

brand_strength.rationale: OpenLLMetry gave the company real developer mindshare and community, though the Traceloop name itself had limited reach outside developers.

outcome_analysis: Traceloop built OpenLLMetry as an open source standard on OpenTelemetry, which gave it wide developer adoption, then launched a commercial platform with a 6.1 million dollar seed in May 2025. ServiceNow announced the acquisition in March 2026, reportedly at 60 to 80 million dollars, to anchor AI governance, a good outcome for a small team.
notes: Seed 6.1M with Sorenson and Ibex confirmed by Business Wire release and Pulse 2; other aggregators say 4.6M or total 6.6M or 6.7M, unverified. Founded year: press says end of 2022, YC page says 2023. Deal date 2026-03-02 per Pitchbook and CB Insights as relayed by search; the 60 to 80M price is a Calcalist report, not confirmed, so amount_usd is null. One aggregator called the deal announced rather than closed. The 2023 launch dates of competitors like LangSmith, Langfuse and Helicone came only from 2025 and 2026 listicles, not sources dated near the batch, so the list is empty.
